transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in today? Is there something specific that’s been troubling you lately?

Yeah… I came in because I just feel restless all the time. Like I’ve got a motor running inside me, and I can’t shut it off. If I have to sit still—like at church, or here at the clinic, or even at home—I start feeling trapped, and I’ve got to get up or do something.
Does this feeling of restlessness happen all the time, or only in certain situations or places?
It’s pretty much all day, not just one place. It shows up at church, here at the clinic, even at home. If I’m supposed to sit still, I start feeling trapped, like I’ve got to get up and do something.
When you feel this restlessness, does it come along with feeling anxious or worried about things?
I don’t really know. I mean, I don’t think I’m sitting there worrying about something specific most of the time. It’s more like my body just won’t settle down.
When you feel this restlessness, do you also feel inner tension or an urge to move, even if you’re not anxious or worried about anything?

Yeah, it’s more like an urge to move. Like there’s a motor running in me all day. Even if I’m not worried about anything, if I have to sit still—at church, here, or even at home—I start feeling trapped and I need to get up or do something.
Have you noticed any actual movements, like rocking, pacing, or fidgeting, when you feel that inner restlessness?

Yeah. I’m usually doing something with my hands or legs. My leg will be bouncing, or I’ll tap my fingers on the chair. Sometimes I’m twisting something in my hands the whole time, even when I’m trying to be respectful and sit still.
Have you ever been on any medications that might have caused this restlessness, especially ones used for mental health, stomach issues, or nausea?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve been on anything like that, at least not that I know of. I haven’t noticed it starting from a medicine or anything.
Is the restlessness something you feel even when you're not sitting still—like when you're standing around or in situations where you don't have to stay quiet or inactive?

Yeah, it’s kind of there all the time. Even if I’m just standing around and don’t have to be quiet, I still feel like there’s a motor going inside me. It’s worse when I have to sit still, like at church or here at the clinic, but even at home I end up needing to get up or do something.
Even when you’re not in situations where you have to sit still or be quiet, do you still feel that inner restlessness or urge to move?

Yeah, I do. It’s like I’ve got a motor running inside me most of the day. Even at home, when nobody’s making me sit still, I still end up needing to get up or do something. If I have to stay seated, like at church or here, I start feeling trapped.
Even when you’re not in any situation where you need to sit still or be quiet, do you still feel that inner restlessness or need to move most of the time?

Yeah, most of the time I do. It feels like I’ve got a motor running inside me all day. Even if I’m just at home, I start feeling trapped if I have to stay still, and I end up having to get up or do something.
Have you noticed times when you feel unusually energetic, need less sleep, or your thoughts race, like you can't slow your mind down?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I feel keyed up a lot, but I haven’t noticed needing less sleep or anything like that. My mind can feel busy sometimes, but I don’t know if I’d call it racing.
Has this restlessness been causing you a lot of distress, or making it hard for you to do things you need to do in your daily life, like work, chores, or being with family?

Yeah, it has. People at church, the pantry, even my own family… they don’t really trust me like they used to with rides or appointments or bringing supplies. I’ll mean to help, I really do, but then I mess it up or can’t follow through, and it makes me feel like I’m letting everybody down.
Have you ever had periods where you felt so good or so hyper that you didn’t want to stop what you were doing, even if it meant staying up late or doing things others might think are risky?
I don’t think so. I mean, I can get worked up and have trouble stopping sometimes, but not like I felt so good I didn’t care about sleep or started doing risky stuff. I haven’t really noticed that.
Have you ever taken any medications that made you feel restless inside, like you couldn’t sit still or had to keep moving?
I don’t think so. I’m not really sure what medicines would do that, but I haven’t noticed one making me feel like I had to keep moving.
Have you ever had a period lasting several days or more where you felt unusually excited, overly confident, or so energetic that you felt like you didn’t need much sleep?
No, I don’t think I’ve had anything like that for several days. I can be restless or keyed up, but not where I feel unusually excited or like I don’t need sleep.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks where you felt down, hopeless, or lost interest in most things?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve had a stretch like that for two weeks where I felt hopeless or lost interest in almost everything. Nothing that stands out to me like that.
